subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 11, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 11, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We're excited to share the latest updates from the AcreetionOS project. First, we'd like to thank everyone who contributed to our recent stable kernel releases. Greg Kroah-Hartman has released the 7.3.4 and 6.18.63 kernels, which are now available for download. These updates bring various bug fixes and improvements to the kernel, ensuring a more stable and secure experience for our users.

In other news, Firefox 160 has been released, featuring several notable updates and improvements. This release includes enhancements to performance, security, and user experience. You can find more information about the release notes on the official Firefox website.

Security updates have also been issued by AlmaLinux, addressing various vulnerabilities in packages such as curl, dpdk, glibc, and more. We recommend updating your system to ensure you have the latest security patches.

On the development front, we've made significant progress on our project. The latest commits include updates to our homepage, newsletter, and wiki guides. Our team has also fixed an issue with the postinstall.sh script in AcreetionOS-Xlibre, ensuring a smoother installation experience.

We're also excited to share that our Carousel Wallpapers project has seen some activity, with new commits and updates. Our team is working hard to bring you the best possible experience with AcreetionOS.

In other news, we've made some changes to our CI/CD pipeline, including passing the -R flag to the gh release create command. This change ensures that our release process is more efficient and reliable.

We'd like to thank our community for their continued support and engagement. Your contributions and feedback are invaluable to us, and we're grateful for the opportunity to work together to build a better Linux distribution.

As always, we're committed to transparency and open communication. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our contact channels.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds for our project, and we're honored to have you along for the ride.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift
